headlines.title: Nvidia stock falls after company opens probe into CEO’s relationship with Chinese spy
headlines.description: Nvidia’s stock slid after the company announced that it had opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with an alleged Chinese spy.

headlines.title: Nvidia opens investigation after CEO’s affair with alleged Chinese spy
headlines.description: Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife in an employee memo. The board said it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.

headlines.title: J.P. Morgan global market strategist on tech stock selloff
headlines.description: Tech stocks in the U.S. steadied after suffering one of their worst routs in years, as investors weighed the prospect of an AI investment slowdown against future gains following broad Democratic victories in the midterms. NBC News' Christine Romans spoke with Jordan Jackson, the executive director and global market strategist for J.P. Morgan, about investment in AI and why he thinks it could be a buying opportunity.

headlines.title: Stock market meltdown over A.I. fears
headlines.description: The NASDAQ fell by more than 5% as big tech companies connected to the A.I. build out led the stock market dramatically lower today. NBC News’ Christine Romans reports on which companies took some of the biggest hits.

headlines.title: Stocks tumble after post-election rally
headlines.description: The stock market took a hit following a post-election rally, as AI fears and data center backlash triggered a tech share sell-off, leading to one of the worst days for the markets since April 2025.

headlines.title: What Do the Midterm Results Mean for Future of AI Data Centers?
headlines.description: The construction of data centers, those sprawling buildings that serve as the engine for artificial intelligence, was rejected on all but one ballot nationwide during Tuesday's midterm elections. Residents object to the centers' drain on electricity and water, the noise they produce, and to the limited economic benefit to their communities. What impact will this pushback have on the economy and growing tech industry? NBC's Allie Canal shares an inside look in this week’s Sunday Focus.

headlines.title: Inside OpenAI’s ‘election war room’ and AI's impact on the midterms
headlines.description: Josh Lawson, Head of Civic and Strategic Risk at OpenAI, speaks with NBC News’ Tom Llamas about the safeguards planned for Election Night and the role AI is playing in the midterms.

headlines.title: TikTok creator makes an interactive website for midterm elections
headlines.description: Can a little TikTok creativity get Gen Z to pay more attention to politics? One content creator is betting on it. She's bringing the Senate races to the internet with a website called “Senate Island,” hoping to make politics a little more entertaining and a lot more accessible.

headlines.title: Google stock's historically bad day raises fears of AI bubble popping
headlines.description: Google's parent company Alphabet lost over $500 billion in market value today. So is the AI bubble about to pop? NBC News' Allie Canal reports on big tech's spending and how AI is impacting the job market.

headlines.title: Spooky book recommendations for Halloween weekend
headlines.description: Abbie Konnick, creator and moderator of the Twisted Book Club, talks with NBC News’ Gadi Schwartz to share her top picks for spooky reads perfect for Halloween weekend.

headlines.title: Portable phone charger explodes on camera inside California home
headlines.description: Surveillance video captures a portable phone charger bursting into flames inside a California home, as a deadly New York City battery fire and a new recall raise safety concerns. NBC News' Andres Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: New report says Nvidia CEO was possible target of Chinese spy plot
headlines.description: A new report from the New York Times reveals that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a possible Chinese spy plot, involving an executive at a Singapore-based company. NBC News has not independently confirmed the details of the investigation.
